notes: GW2 source paths are logical names the extractor must resolve from Frostbite bundles at first-run. tf2_slot is the exact filename the TF2 engine will try to load from tf/custom/pvz_gw2_kit/sound/. Each row ships a stock-TF2 fallback so missing GW2 content never crashes the match.

team_gating.mechanism: TF2 cannot natively branch sound by team for a shared class. For slots that collide (scout BLU vs scout RED), we author two sound script entries with distinct wave paths and switch the active VPK via a tf_bot_force_class listener in cfg/mods/pvz_gw2_kit.cfg. See hooks.json#vo_team_gating.

rules.note: Chomper VO is largely muffled growls — maps cleanly to Pyro's masked mumbles.
Jarate maps to Cactus's Garlic Drone marker VO — cheeky.
Engineer doesn't call medic much, but Scientist IS the healer — this is a self-chatter line.

coverage_targets.note: Full per-line sheet (every TF2 VO slot × 8 kits) is ~400 rows. This sheet lists the structural template + every P0 slot that must play on first boot. Remaining slots are generated by the extractor via sounds.template.json (next sheet, Phase 2).

open_cells.blocker: All paths are inferred. Real Frostbite bundle layout confirmed only after Phase 3 extraction. Extractor must emit a manifest.json so this sheet can be auto-reconciled.
